subject: How to specify mean of hyperpriors for a distribution

messages.author: 87e020c3fd9325fa
messages.subject: How to specify mean of hyperpriors for a distribution
parts:
Hi,

I would like to specify a mean and precision for the prior distribution in my model.  if it was, for instance, a Beta distribution that I wanted to force to have parameters alpha=0.5 and beta=1, how would I do this?  From my reading,  it looks as though it is possible to specify the precision of the hyperpriors,  but not the mean.  is this correct?

for example, one can specify the distribution for the precision using control.family(list(hyper=list(prec=c(0.1,0.1)))).  is there something similar for the mean?

Thanks
TB

> is possible to specify the precision of the hyperpriors,  but not the
> mean.  is this correct?
>
> for example, one can specify the distribution for the precision using
> control.family(list(hyper=list(prec=c(0.1,0.1)))).  is there
> something similar for the mean?

inla.doc("beta")

for example

control.family = list(hyper = list(
rho = list(
prior = "betacorrelation",
param = c(a, b))))



if you need more than this; let me know ;-)
